rem Tidying Up
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=253
rem N numbered pieces are picked at
rem random and put in place in a line,
rem in segments that merge as the line
rem builds up. Find the expected most
rem segments seen at any time, to 6
rem places.

use numbers
use algo
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg N integer = 40

rem Run backward, the full line has one
rem segment and a random cell goes each
rem turn. A state is the multiset of
rem segment lengths, as counts of each
rem length, found from the full line
rem with the moves, each cell of a
rem segment splitting it in a and L - 1
rem - a, equal pairs once and others
rem twice. For each state and j, G is
rem the chance the segments never exceed
rem j from there on. It is zero when the
rem state has more than j, else the
rem average of G over the next states, 1
rem when none is left. The expected most
rem is the sum over j of 1 - G of the
rem full line.
Rd = N + 1
Pw = Rd ** (0 to N array)
Cap = 60000
Cnt = array shape (Cap * (N + 1)) fill 0
Ky = array shape Cap fill 0
Prt = array shape Cap fill 0
Tot = array shape Cap fill 0
Tb = array shape (Cap + 1) fill 0
To = array shape 800000 fill 0
Wt = array shape 800000 fill 0
Idx = new index
Cnt N = 1
Ky 0 = Pw N
Prt 0 = 1
Tot 0 = N
Idx (Pw N) = 0
Ns = 1
Nt = 0
I = 0
for
  if I equal Ns
    break
  end
  Tb I = Nt
  Bs = I * (N + 1)
  for L in 1 to N
    C = Cnt (Bs + L)
    if C equal 0
      continue
    end
    for A in 0 to ((L - 1) // 2)
      B = L - 1 - A
      W = C
      if A not equal B
        W = 2 * C
      end
      Nk = Ky I - Pw L
      Np = Prt I - 1
      if A greater 0
        Nk += Pw A
        Np += 1
      end
      if B greater 0
        Nk += Pw B
        Np += 1
      end
      Nid = 0
      if Nk in Idx
        Nid = Idx Nk
      else
        Nid = Ns
        Idx Nk = Ns
        Nb = Nid * (N + 1)
        for J in 1 to N
          Cnt (Nb + J) = Cnt (Bs + J)
        end
        Cnt (Nb + L) = Cnt (Nb + L) - 1
        if A greater 0
          Ca = Nb + A
          Cnt Ca = Cnt Ca + 1
        end
        if B greater 0
          Cb = Nb + B
          Cnt Cb = Cnt Cb + 1
        end
        Ky Nid = Nk
        Prt Nid = Np
        Tot Nid = Tot I - 1
        Ns += 1
      end
      To Nt = Nid
      Wt Nt = W
      Nt += 1
    end
  end
  I += 1
end
Tb Ns = Nt
Jm = N + 2
G = array shape (Ns * Jm) fill 0.0
Js = 0 till Jm array
for K in 0 till Ns
  S = Ns - 1 - K
  Rw = S * Jm
  if Tot S equal 0
    for J in 0 till Jm
      G (Rw + J) = 1.0
    end
    continue
  end
  for J in (Prt S) till Jm
    V = 0.0
    for T in (Tb S) till (Tb (S + 1))
      V += G (To T * Jm + J) * Wt T
    end
    G (Rw + J) = V / Tot S
  end
end
G0 = G (0 till Jm)
Answer = (1 - G0) sum round 6
Answer print

rem Tidying Up
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=253
rem N numbered pieces are picked at
rem random and put in place in a line,
rem in segments that merge as the line
rem builds up. Find the expected most
rem segments seen at any time, to 6
rem places.

use numbers
use algo
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg N integer = 40

rem Run backward, the full line has one
rem segment and a random cell goes each
rem turn. A state is the multiset of
rem segment lengths, as counts of each
rem length, found from the full line
rem with the moves, each cell of a
rem segment splitting it in a and L - 1
rem - a, equal pairs once and others
rem twice. For each state and j, G is
rem the chance the segments never exceed
rem j from there on. It is zero when the
rem state has more than j, else the
rem average of G over the next states, 1
rem when none is left. The expected most
rem is the sum over j of 1 - G of the
rem full line.
Rd = N + 1
Pw = Rd ** (0 to N array)
Cap = 60000
Cnt = array shape (Cap * (N + 1)) fill 0
Ky = array shape Cap fill 0
Prt = array shape Cap fill 0
Tot = array shape Cap fill 0
Mx = array shape Cap fill 0
Tb = array shape (Cap + 1) fill 0
To = array shape 800000 fill 0
Wt = array shape 800000 fill 0
Idx = new index
Cnt N = 1
Ky 0 = Pw N
Prt 0 = 1
Tot 0 = N
Mx 0 = (N + 1) // 2
Idx (Pw N) = 0
Ns = 1
Nt = 0
I = 0
for
  if I equal Ns
    break
  end
  Tb I = Nt
  Bs = I * (N + 1)
  for L in 1 to N
    C = Cnt (Bs + L)
    if C equal 0
      continue
    end
    for A in 0 to ((L - 1) // 2)
      B = L - 1 - A
      W = C
      if A not equal B
        W = 2 * C
      end
      Nk = Ky I - Pw L
      Np = Prt I - 1
      if A greater 0
        Nk += Pw A
        Np += 1
      end
      if B greater 0
        Nk += Pw B
        Np += 1
      end
      Nid = 0
      if Nk in Idx
        Nid = Idx Nk
      else
        Nid = Ns
        Idx Nk = Ns
        Nb = Nid * (N + 1)
        Cnt ((Nb + 1) till (Nb + N + 1)) = Cnt ((Bs + 1) till (Bs + N + 1))
        Cnt (Nb + L) = Cnt (Nb + L) - 1
        if A greater 0
          Ca = Nb + A
          Cnt Ca = Cnt Ca + 1
        end
        if B greater 0
          Cb = Nb + B
          Cnt Cb = Cnt Cb + 1
        end
        Ky Nid = Nk
        Prt Nid = Np
        Tot Nid = Tot I - 1
        Mx Nid = Mx I - (L + 1) // 2 + (A + 1) // 2 + (B + 1) // 2
        Ns += 1
      end
      To Nt = Nid
      Wt Nt = W
      Nt += 1
    end
  end
  I += 1
end
Tb Ns = Nt
Jm = (N + 1) // 2 + 1
G = array shape (Ns * Jm) fill 0.0
Js = 0 till Jm array
for K in 0 till Ns
  S = Ns - 1 - K
  Rw = S * Jm
  for J in (Mx S) till Jm
    G (Rw + J) = 1.0
  end
  for J in (Prt S) till (Mx S)
    V = 0.0
    for T in (Tb S) till (Tb (S + 1))
      V += G (To T * Jm + J) * Wt T
    end
    G (Rw + J) = V / Tot S
  end
end
G0 = G (0 till Jm)
Answer = (1 - G0) sum round 6
Answer print
